name: one_blocking_statement
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_blocking_statement ON operations(offer) WHERE state IN ('prepared','dispatching','uncertain','committed')

name: sessions_credential
sql: CREATE INDEX sessions_credential ON sessions(credential)

name: atomic_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE atomic_meta(scope TEXT NOT NULL)

name: atomic_rows
sql: CREATE TABLE atomic_rows(namespace TEXT NOT NULL,k TEXT NOT NULL,v TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(namespace,k))

name: authority_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE authority_meta (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), version INTEGER NOT NULL, environment TEXT NOT NULL, audience TEXT NOT NULL)

name: binding_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE binding_meta(scope TEXT NOT NULL)

name: bindings
sql: CREATE TABLE bindings(mandate TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL, credential TEXT NOT NULL, household TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL)

name: challenges
sql: CREATE TABLE challenges (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, challenge TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: credentials
sql: CREATE TABLE credentials (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id), revoked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revoked IN (0,1)))

name: enrollment_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE enrollment_meta (scope TEXT NOT NULL)

name: flows
sql: CREATE TABLE flows (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL, handle TEXT NOT NULL, challenge TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: handles
sql: CREATE TABLE handles (principal TEXT PRIMARY KEY, handle TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

name: invitations
sql: CREATE TABLE invitations (digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL)

name: login_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE login_meta (scope TEXT NOT NULL)

name: operation_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE operation_meta(scope TEXT NOT NULL)

name: operations
sql: CREATE TABLE operations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, offer TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('prepared','dispatching','uncertain','committed','cancelled','refused')), record TEXT NOT NULL)

name: ownership
sql: CREATE TABLE ownership (kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('offer','mandate')), id TEXT NOT NULL, household TEXT NOT NULL, presenter TEXT, invalidated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(invalidated IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(kind,id), CHECK((kind='offer' AND presenter IS NOT NULL) OR (kind='mandate' AND presenter IS NULL)))

name: passkeys
sql: CREATE TABLE passkeys (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, public_key BLOB NOT NULL, counter INTEGER NOT NULL, user_handle TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)))

name: principals
sql: CREATE TABLE principals (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, household TEXT NOT NULL, presenters TEXT NOT NULL, disabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(disabled IN (0,1)))

name: sessions
sql: CREATE TABLE sessions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, credential TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES credentials(id), expires INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revoked IN (0,1)))

name: statement_review_meta
sql: CREATE TABLE statement_review_meta(scope TEXT NOT NULL)

name: statement_reviews
sql: CREATE TABLE statement_reviews(operation TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operations(id), record TEXT NOT NULL)
